typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' - Sturdy, highly legible, optimized for numeric data and dense tables.

headings.usage: H1-H4, KPI primary numbers, Dashboard titles

body.usage: Tables, client lists, transaction histories, input fields

mono.usage: Account numbers, transaction IDs, specific technical labels

primary.description: Deep Forest Green. Represents wealth, stability, and trust.

accent.description: Rust/Terracotta for expenses, arrears, and negative balances.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp solid borders (border-border). Avoid soft, blurry borders.
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness. Use 'rounded-md' (6px) or 'rounded-sm' (4px) universally. Avoid excessive pill shapes except for status badges.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. 'shadow-sm' for cards, 'shadow-md' for dropdowns. Avoid large ambient shadows. Rely on borders for definition.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat solid colors only. NO glassmorphism. Financial data requires 100% optical clarity and high contrast.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with 'duotone' or 'regular' weight for a professional, high-end feel.

layouts.spacing: Generous outer padding (p-4 mobile, p-8 desktop). Tight internal padding for tables and lists to maximize data density.

responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first. Design for 320px-430px first, then scale up using Tailwind md: and lg: prefixes.
responsive.navigation: Desktop: Collapsible Sidebar (w-64 to w-16). Mobile: Fixed Bottom Navigation Bar with 4-5 primary icons (Inicio, Clientes, Nuevo, Cobros, Menú).
responsive.tables: On mobile, convert dense tables into stacked cards (List view). Keep tables for desktop/tablet only. NEVER force horizontal scroll on primary data if it can be stacked.
responsive.modals: On desktop: standard centered Dialog. On mobile: Full-screen Slide-over (Sheet) or Bottom Sheet to maximize tap space.
responsive.tap_targets: All interactive elements (buttons, row items) MUST be at least 44x44px on mobile.
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure `overflow-x-hidden` on main wrapper to prevent horizontal scrolling on mobile.

components.buttons: Large, full-width on mobile for key actions ('COBRAR CUOTA', 'NUEVO PRÉSTAMO'). Solid primary color, sharp radius.
components.cards: White background (`bg-white`), 1px neutral border, subtle shadow. Title in uppercase overline style, main value in massive bold font.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Dense rows. ALL numeric columns (amounts) MUST be text-right aligned. Status columns should use colored dot badges.
components.charts: Recharts. Line charts for income/expense trends. Bar charts for cash flow. Use primary green and accent red.
components.forms: Shadcn Forms. Labels left-aligned above inputs. Required asterisks in red. Confirmations (Alert Dialog) REQUIRED before submitting payments or cancellations.

motion.hover: Subtle background shifts (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-50) and slight translation (hover:-translate-y-[1px]).
motion.page_transition: Simple fade in. No complex staggers for financial tools.
motion.interactive: Active states must have visible scale down (active:scale-[0.98]).

accessibility.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA compliant. Text on primary buttons must be white. Avoid light grey text on white.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, table rows) MUST include `data-testid` in kebab-case.

data_formatting.currency: Paraguayan Guaraníes (Gs.). ALWAYS format with thousand separators (dots) and NO decimals. Example: 'Gs. 1.500.000'.

login_background.description: Minimalist modern architecture. Use as a half-screen or background for the login/register page to imply structure, wealth, and stability.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a financial application. Prioritize clarity, speed, and accuracy over flashy visuals.
ALWAYS format currency as Gs. with dot separators (e.g., Gs. 5.000.000). Never use decimals.
Implement a Mobile-first bottom navigation bar. Financial collectors use this app on the streets. Large tap targets for 'Cobrar' (Collect) are critical.
Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) for all icons.
Do NOT use glassmorphism or transparent overlays for data containers. Use solid #FFFFFF with crisp 1px borders.
In tables, always right-align monetary values so users can easily compare digits.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for layouts, but rely on Shadcn for interactive components (Select, Dialog, Form, Table).
Before critical actions (Payment, Cancellation, Renewal), trigger a Shadcn Alert Dialog for confirmation.
Integrate WhatsApp sharing using a simple link format (https://wa.me/?text=...).
For PDF generation, ensure the layout is printer-friendly (black and white, clear typography).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Ensure layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do NOT apply 'transition: all'. Target specific properties.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use emoji characters for icons.
Provide micro-animations for interactions (hover, focus, active).
